heading: ## The leg ledger — replay, receipt, and how it is read (round 7, measured)

findings.quote:
dated milestones: seven from round 16, eight from round 18, nine from
round 26, ten from round 51
findings.why: The parenthetical presents itself as the dated milestone chain of the leg count but starts at seven, so the growth from the four legs just named to seven has no dated step; the runner the section cites records the missing stage explicitly (`tools/mutate-and-run.sh:84` at C1: `r10-2 six legs; r16 seven; ...`), and `SKILL.md:1328` dates the same six-leg state to r10-2, so a cold reader cannot date when the ledger became five or six.
